chunks.text: Slow English podcast, A1 little host Emili.
Topic, Colonial Del Sacramento, part one.
Hello everyone.
My name is Emily.
Welcome to the Slow English podcast.
In this podcast, we speak slow and easy English.
Today we talk about a small and beautiful city.
The city is Colonial Del Sacramento.
Colonial Del Sacramento is in Uruguay.
Uruguay is a country in South America.
The city is near a big river called the Rio de la Plata.
It is a quiet and historical place.
Part two, Colonial Del Sacramento is a very old city.
It was founded in the year 1680.
The city has a long history with Spain and Portugal.
Because of this, the architecture has different styles.
Part three, the old town is the most famous part of the city.
It is called the historic quarter.
This area is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
The streets are made of stone and are very charming.
Part four, walking in the old town is very relaxing.
There are small streets, old houses and quiet corners.
Many streets have trees and flowers.
Visitors enjoy walking slowly and taking photos.
Part five, one famous street is called Caledelo Suspiros.
In English, it means street of size.
This street is very old and beautiful.
It has colorful houses and a romantic atmosphere.
Part six, Colonial also has a lighthouse.
Visitors can climb to the top of the lighthouse.
From there, they can see the river and the city.
The view is very nice and peaceful.
The city has many small museums.
These museums tell the history of the city.
Visitors can learn about the past and the people who live there.
The museums are small but interesting.
Part eight, food in colonia is simple and delicious.
People eat meat, fish and fresh vegetables.
There are many small restaurants and cafes.
Visitors enjoy eating outside and watching the streets.
Part nine, the river is an important part of the city.
People walk near the water and enjoy the view.
Sunset by the river is very beautiful.
The sky becomes orange and pink.
Part 10, colonia is a calm and slow city.
Life is not fast like in big cities.
People relax, walk and enjoy simple things.
It is a perfect place to rest.
Part 11, many visitors come from Argentina.
Buenos Aires is very close to colonia.
People travel by boat across the river.
It is a popular day trip.
Part 12, colonia del Sacramento is a small city with great charm.
The old streets, the river and the peaceful life make it special.
Visitors enjoy history, nature and quiet moments.
Even though it is not very big, it is a wonderful place to discover.
Thank you for listening to the slow English part.
